entries.summary_pt_br: Coleção oficial atual de exemplos de plugins para ChatGPT e Codex, incluindo pacotes somente com skills e pacotes apoiados por MCP.

entries.summary_pt_br: Cria e depura aplicativos iOS com SwiftUI, App Intents, Xcode, Simulator e fluxos de desempenho e memória.

entries.summary_pt_br: Cria, testa, instrumenta e depura apps nativos para macOS com SwiftUI, AppKit, Xcode, assinatura e logs unificados.

entries.summary_pt_br: Cria aplicativos web com foco no frontend, recursos visuais, testes no navegador, componentes de UI, pagamentos e bancos de dados.

entries.summary_pt_br: Desenvolve com as APIs da OpenAI, Agents SDK e aplicativos do ChatGPT usando documentação e fluxos oficiais.

entries.summary_pt_br: Avalia e compara skills e plugins do Codex com relatórios locais, explicações de pontuação e medição de tokens.

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.summary_en: A software-development skill framework covering brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, collaboration, and code review.
entries.summary_pt_br: Framework de skills para desenvolvimento de software com ideação, planejamento, TDD, depuração, colaboração e revisão de código.

entries.name: Build Web Data Visualization

entries.summary_pt_br: Projeta, implementa, testa e exporta gráficos, mapas, painéis, diagramas e narrativas visuais para navegador.

entries.name: Data Analytics
entries.summary_en: Answer product and business questions with data, validation, diagnostics, charts, dashboards, notebooks, and reports.
entries.summary_pt_br: Responde perguntas de produto e negócio com validação, diagnóstico, gráficos, painéis, notebooks e relatórios.

entries.name: Life Science Research
entries.summary_en: Route and synthesize evidence across genetics, omics, biology, chemistry, clinical research, and public datasets.
entries.summary_pt_br: Direciona e sintetiza evidências de genética, ômicas, biologia, química, pesquisa clínica e bases públicas.

entries.name: Creative Production
entries.summary_en: Turn briefs, products, and source images into campaign concepts, mood boards, ads, social posts, and launch assets.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma briefings, produtos e imagens em conceitos de campanha, painéis de referência, anúncios, posts e materiais de lançamento.

entries.name: Figma
entries.summary_en: Implement Figma designs in code, create Code Connect templates, and generate project-specific design-system rules.
entries.summary_pt_br: Implementa designs do Figma em código, cria modelos Code Connect e gera regras de design system específicas do projeto.

entries.name: Product Design
entries.summary_en: Turn early ideas, URLs, screenshots, and briefs into reviewable product directions, UX audits, and interactive prototypes.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma ideias, URLs, capturas e briefings em direções de produto, auditorias de UX e protótipos interativos.

entries.name: Remotion
entries.summary_en: Create programmatic videos with React using reusable guidance for animation, audio, captions, charts, 3D, and transitions.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria vídeos programáticos com React usando orientações para animação, áudio, legendas, gráficos, 3D e transições.

entries.name: Google Drive
entries.summary_en: Use one entry point for Google Drive search, organization, sharing, and Docs, Sheets, and Slides workflows.
entries.summary_pt_br: Usa uma entrada única para pesquisar, organizar e compartilhar no Drive e trabalhar com Docs, Sheets e Slides.

entries.name: Notion
entries.summary_en: Turn specifications, research, meetings, and workspace context into plans, documentation, and durable knowledge.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma especificações, pesquisas, reuniões e contexto do workspace em planos, documentação e conhecimento durável.

entries.name: Codex Security
entries.summary_en: Run reusable security scanning, analysis, validation, triage, and investigation workflows across code and diffs.
entries.summary_pt_br: Executa fluxos reutilizáveis de varredura, análise, validação, triagem e investigação de segurança em código e diffs.

entries.name: Regenerative Impact Map
entries.summary_en: Map a consequential decision across five systemic lenses, causal loops, power, delays, spillovers, and reversible leverage points.
entries.summary_pt_br: Mapeia uma decisão relevante por cinco áreas sistêmicas, ciclos causais, poder, atrasos, efeitos indiretos e pontos de alavancagem reversíveis.

human.mechanism: Makes agency, safety, accessibility, and workload effects explicit before selection.
human.indicator: Material human effects with an owner, measure, and mitigation.

social.mechanism: Includes affected non-users, missing voices, maintainers, and power differences.
social.indicator: Participation gaps and unowned social effects remaining at review.

knowledge.mechanism: Leaves a reusable causal map with assumptions, delays, and unknowns.
knowledge.indicator: Priority unknowns resolved and decisions that reuse the map.

resources.mechanism: Compares separate attention, time, money, compute, data, material, and energy effects.
resources.indicator: Measured use against baseline for each material resource type.

ecology.mechanism: Includes the living environment and delayed ecological spillovers inside the boundary.
ecology.indicator: Locally relevant ecological thresholds and measures assigned to the decision.

systemic_review.harm_check: All five lenses are inspected; every material spillover needs an owner, mitigation, stop rule, or no-go decision.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: A better map improves decisions, which produce evidence that improves the next map.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Stop conditions, reversibility, and separate resource limits prevent reinforcing harm or analysis without action.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A governed system map, indicator set, and review cadence reusable by later decisions.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare each material resource in its own unit with the current decision process.
resource_ledger.restoration: Assign restoration for failed interventions and preserve the map as shared capacity.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Affected readers can restate the choice, main tradeoff, and stop condition.

entries.name: Regenerative Language Bridge
entries.summary_en: Explain complex material in everyday language while retaining exact terms, evidence, uncertainty, caveats, and a check of real understanding.
entries.summary_pt_br: Explica conteúdo complexo em linguagem cotidiana, preservando termos exatos, evidências, incertezas, ressalvas e a verificação do entendimento real.

human.mechanism: Reduces comprehension barriers while preserving the reader's path to technical depth.
human.indicator: Teach-back accuracy and successful independent next action.

social.mechanism: Creates shared language between specialists and affected non-specialists.
social.indicator: Misunderstandings and avoidable clarification cycles at review.

knowledge.mechanism: Pairs a plain layer with precise terms, evidence, caveats, and a reusable glossary.
knowledge.indicator: Verified comprehension, glossary reuse, and corrected ambiguous terms.

resources.mechanism: Designs information around the reader's attention and the maintainer's update cost.
resources.indicator: Reading time, avoidable follow-up, and maintenance effort versus baseline.

systemic_review.harm_check: The workflow checks all five lenses and forbids simplification that hides a material caveat or ecological consequence.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Reader feedback improves the glossary and explanation, making later understanding and contribution easier.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Teach-back, source preservation, and expiry dates stop false simplicity and stale certainty.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A reusable, corrected glossary and two-layer explanation that lowers the cost of future learning.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare reading, clarification, translation, and maintenance effort with the original material.
resource_ledger.restoration: Return corrections to the shared glossary and retire explanations that no longer match the source.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Use teach-back or three audience-specific questions instead of relying on readability scores.

entries.name: Regenerative Participatory Decision
entries.summary_en: Design a fair, traceable decision in which affected people have clear influence, dissent is preserved, and every participant receives a response.
entries.summary_pt_br: Projeta uma decisão justa e rastreável na qual pessoas afetadas têm influência clara, divergências são preservadas e todos recebem retorno.

human.mechanism: Clarifies agency, access needs, consent, and the burden of participation.
human.indicator: Access barriers, participation burden, and informed withdrawal.

social.mechanism: Makes authority, influence, dissent, commitments, and feedback closure visible.
social.indicator: Representation gaps, closed commitments, and trust after the decision.

knowledge.mechanism: Gives participants a shared brief and preserves reasoning, uncertainty, and minority views.
knowledge.indicator: Decision record completeness and assumptions corrected by participants.

resources.mechanism: Uses the lightest legitimate participation mode and budgets access and follow-up.
resources.indicator: Participant time, compensation, facilitation, and unresolved follow-up versus plan.

systemic_review.harm_check: All five lenses are compared, including delayed ecological and resource costs, before applying the declared decision rule.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Visible influence and returned reasons build trust, improving participation and later decisions.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: A fixed scope, deadline, minority protections, and reopening triggers limit capture and endless consultation.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A reusable decision record, stronger participation capability, and accountable commitments.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare participation and implementation burden with the existing decision route.
resource_ledger.restoration: Compensate material burden where appropriate and close or release every commitment at review.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Participants can state what they can influence, the rule, and how they will hear back.

entries.name: Regenerative Listening Loop
entries.summary_en: Build an ethical listen–understand–act–report-back cycle that gives affected people real influence and avoids extractive consultation.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria um ciclo ético de escutar, compreender, agir e devolver que oferece influência real e evita consultas extrativistas.

human.mechanism: Uses consent, accessible channels, privacy, and explicit limits on what feedback can change.
human.indicator: Consent quality, access gaps, participant burden, and safeguarding events.

social.mechanism: Validates findings with participants and returns action or reasons to everyone who contributed.
social.indicator: Response coverage, fulfilled actions, missing voices, and reported trust.

knowledge.mechanism: Preserves themes, exceptions, dissent, provenance, and corrections instead of averaging them away.
knowledge.indicator: Participant-validated themes, recorded exceptions, and corrections.

resources.mechanism: Budgets participant attention, compensation, facilitation, data retention, and follow-up.
resources.indicator: Actual burden and follow-up cost against the stated budget.

systemic_review.harm_check: The process inspects all five lenses and stops when nothing can change or when burden and risk exceed likely value.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Listening followed by visible action grows trust and better evidence for the next action.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Influence boundaries, data minimization, fatigue limits, and protection of exceptions prevent extraction and majority dominance.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A reusable action register, improved relationship, and feedback method corrected by participants.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare participant and organizer burden with the previous feedback route.
resource_ledger.restoration: Return findings and value to participants, compensate where warranted, and delete data at expiry.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Participants can explain what was heard, what will change, who owns it, and when.

entries.name: Regenerative Knowledge Commons
entries.summary_en: Turn project learning into accessible, reusable, rights-aware knowledge with provenance, stewardship, correction, contribution, and expiry paths.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma aprendizados em conhecimento acessível, reutilizável e atento a direitos, com proveniência, curadoria, correção, contribuição e validade.

human.mechanism: Makes learning accessible to its legitimate audience and supports independent use.
human.indicator: Successful use, comprehension, and unresolved access barriers.

social.mechanism: Keeps rights, attribution, collective benefit, authority, and contribution paths visible.
social.indicator: Credited contributions, governance issues, and value returned to knowledge holders.

knowledge.mechanism: Adds provenance, precise terms, versioning, correction, reuse, and expiry to durable learning.
knowledge.indicator: Successful reuse, corrections, provenance coverage, and stale assets retired.

resources.mechanism: Reduces rediscovery while budgeting storage, compute, maintenance, privacy, and deletion.
resources.indicator: Avoided repeated work and actual stewardship cost versus baseline.

systemic_review.harm_check: All five lenses are inspected; open access never overrides privacy, collective rights, safety, or ecological cost.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Responsible reuse generates corrections and contributions that improve the shared asset for later reuse.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Access classes, stewards, version history, expiry, and deletion prevent stale, extractive, or excessive accumulation.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A governed knowledge asset whose reuse, correction, and retirement paths survive a handoff.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare rediscovery and handoff effort with storage, maintenance, retrieval, and review cost.
resource_ledger.restoration: Return value to knowledge holders and delete or archive assets that no longer justify their cost.

plain_language.comprehension_check: A legitimate new user can find, interpret, apply, question, and correct the asset.

entries.name: Regenerative Resource Cycle
entries.summary_en: Redesign a lifecycle by avoiding demand first, circulating resources safely, checking rebound, and committing to measurable restoration.
entries.summary_pt_br: Redesenha um ciclo de vida começando por evitar demanda, circular recursos com segurança, verificar o efeito rebote e restaurar de forma mensurável.

human.mechanism: Counts safety, accessibility, labor, maintenance, time, and attention across the lifecycle.
human.indicator: Hazard exposure, user burden, repair access, and unpaid work versus baseline.

social.mechanism: Makes ownership, return paths, incentives, and exported burdens explicit.
social.indicator: Return participation, burden distribution, and community value retained.

knowledge.mechanism: Leaves accessible repair, maintenance, material, and recovery instructions.
knowledge.indicator: Successful repair and recovery using the documentation.

resources.mechanism: Applies avoid-to-dispose hierarchy and measures unlike resources in separate ledgers.
resources.indicator: Demand, lifetime, utilization, recovery, and waste by resource-specific unit.

ecology.mechanism: Maps extraction, energy, water, toxicity, transport, recovery, and end-of-life effects.
ecology.indicator: Locally material ecological measure improves without an exported hotspot.

systemic_review.harm_check: The whole lifecycle and all five lenses are checked for hazardous work, rebound, leakage, and exported waste.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Repairable design and shared recovery knowledge increase return and reuse, financing better maintenance and design.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Demand caps, resource budgets, hazard rules, and rebound triggers limit increased total use and unsafe circulation.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A maintained return path, repair capability, and an explicit restoration commitment for the next cycle.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Measure each material lifecycle flow in its own unit before and after the reversible pilot.
resource_ledger.restoration: Restore a named resource or system function beyond avoided loss and verify it separately.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Users and maintainers can explain the return, repair, hazard, and rebound rules.

entries.name: Regenerative Resilience Plan
entries.summary_en: Prepare essential functions to prevent, absorb, adapt to, recover from, and learn through disruption without shifting risk to vulnerable people.
entries.summary_pt_br: Prepara funções essenciais para prevenir, absorver, adaptar-se, recuperar-se e aprender com rupturas sem transferir riscos a pessoas vulneráveis.

human.mechanism: Prioritizes essential needs, safety, accessibility, agency, and people hit first or recovering last.
human.indicator: Unmet essential needs, unsafe workload, access failures, and recovery time.

social.mechanism: Distributes roles, decision rights, mutual aid, communication, and critical capability.
social.indicator: Single points of human failure, network reach, and mutual-aid activation.

knowledge.mechanism: Uses scenarios and drills to turn surprises into updated shared practice.
knowledge.indicator: Drill findings closed, assumptions corrected, and roles demonstrated.

resources.mechanism: Creates proportionate reserves, redundancy, modularity, backups, and restoration plans.
resources.indicator: Minimum service duration, reserve adequacy, recovery cost, and restoration completion.

ecology.mechanism: Includes environmental hazards, dependencies, cascading effects, and maladaptation.
ecology.indicator: Locally relevant ecological thresholds and dependencies tested in scenarios.

systemic_review.harm_check: All five lenses and compound scenarios are checked, with special attention to risks shifted onto vulnerable people or ecosystems.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Small drills expose gaps, shared learning improves readiness, and safer responses create better evidence for later drills.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Workload limits, decentralization, activation thresholds, stop rules, and maladaptation checks prevent brittle over-preparation.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: Distributed response capability, mutual-aid relationships, and a plan improved by every safe exercise.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare prevention, reserve, response, and recovery needs with current capacity by scenario.
resource_ledger.restoration: Define how services, reserves, affected people, and damaged living systems will be restored after activation.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Each role holder can state the trigger, first action, fallback, escalation, and recovery condition.

entries.name: Regenerative Capability Exchange
entries.summary_en: Create reciprocal exchanges that start from existing strengths and distribute practical capability instead of dependence on one expert.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria trocas recíprocas que partem de capacidades existentes e distribuem habilidade prática em vez de dependência de um especialista.

human.mechanism: Combines demonstration, practice, teach-back, and independent action on a real task.
human.indicator: Calibrated performance, agency, and successful independent completion.

social.mechanism: Maps gifts as well as needs and establishes voluntary, credited, accessible, reciprocal exchange.
social.indicator: Reciprocity, relationship diversity, access gaps, and concentrated burden.

knowledge.mechanism: Rotates learner, teacher, documenter, and facilitator roles and preserves precise reusable guidance.
knowledge.indicator: Peer-to-peer transfer, corrected guidance, and critical capabilities with multiple holders.

resources.mechanism: Budgets preparation, compensation, access, tools, space, and follow-up.
resources.indicator: Actual exchange cost and reduced dependency cost versus baseline.

systemic_review.harm_check: All five lenses are inspected; cultural restrictions, ecological effects, unpaid expertise, gatekeeping, and safety-critical limits remain visible.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Learners become teachers and improve the shared guide, expanding the network's capacity to teach others.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Consent, fair compensation, workload caps, attribution, and competence checks prevent extraction and false confidence.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: More than one capable person, a reusable learning asset, and a reciprocal relationship able to continue without the initiator.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare exchange cost with repeated outsourcing, bottleneck, and rediscovery costs.
resource_ledger.restoration: Return value and credit to knowledge holders and replenish shared tools or spaces used by the exchange.

plain_language.comprehension_check: A learner demonstrates the real task and can explain when to seek deeper expertise.

entries.name: Regenerative Conflict Repair
entries.summary_en: Assess safety before structuring voluntary conflict repair across immediate harm, relationships, procedures, and systemic causes.
entries.summary_pt_br: Avalia a segurança antes de estruturar reparação voluntária de conflitos nos danos imediatos, relações, procedimentos e causas sistêmicas.

human.mechanism: Places safety, consent, agency, impact, needs, accessibility, and exit rights before dialogue.
human.indicator: Safety events, voluntary continuation, burden, and recurrence of individual harm.

social.mechanism: Links accountability and repair to relationship practices and structural prevention.
social.indicator: Commitments completed, recurrence, retaliation, and reported ability to coordinate safely.

knowledge.mechanism: Separates observations, interpretations, disputed facts, patterns, and lessons without inventing certainty.
knowledge.indicator: Disputed assumptions clarified and prevention learning incorporated into procedure.

resources.mechanism: Budgets emotional labor, advocacy, facilitation, access, time, restitution, and follow-up.
resources.indicator: Burden distribution, support delivered, and repair commitments completed.

systemic_review.harm_check: A mandatory safety gate examines all five lenses and routes violence, coercion, retaliation, discrimination, and regulated matters away from informal dialogue.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Completed accountability and structural prevention can rebuild enough safety for earlier reporting and better prevention.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Separate consent, advocates, no-contact options, stop rules, formal routes, and private follow-up prevent coerced closure.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: A voluntary repair record and changed condition that reduces recurrence rather than merely ending discussion.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Compare repair and support burden with continuing harm, recurrence, and the appropriate formal route.
resource_ledger.restoration: Complete agreed restitution or support and repair the procedure that allowed recurrence where authority permits.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Each participant can state rights, process, commitments, stop rules, confidentiality limits, and exit routes.

entries.name: Regenerative Adaptive Experiment
entries.summary_en: Convert uncertainty into a small, reversible test with causal predictions, systemic measures, early harm detection, rollback, and reusable learning.
entries.summary_pt_br: Converte incerteza em teste pequeno e reversível, com previsão causal, medidas sistêmicas, detecção precoce de danos, reversão e aprendizado reutilizável.

human.mechanism: Limits exposure, obtains consent, designs access, and measures benefit and burden for affected people.
human.indicator: Outcome, access, workload, safety, and withdrawal measures by affected group.

social.mechanism: Returns results and dissent to participants and assigns authority, ownership, and next decisions.
social.indicator: Participant feedback returned, commitments closed, and distributional effects reviewed.

knowledge.mechanism: Tests an explicit causal prediction and preserves context, deviations, contrary results, and uncertainty.
knowledge.indicator: Key uncertainty reduced and evidence reused by the next decision.

resources.mechanism: Constrains the test's time, attention, money, compute, data, material, energy, and disruption.
resources.indicator: Actual use by resource type versus test budget and baseline.

systemic_review.harm_check: All five lenses receive balancing measures or explicit non-material findings before scale-up; unknown high-stakes harm stops the test.
systemic_review.reinforcing_loop: Small tests generate reusable evidence that improves the next hypothesis and makes later tests safer and more informative.
systemic_review.balancing_safeguard: Exposure limits, balancing measures, consent renewal, stop thresholds, rollback, and restoration prevent scale from outrunning learning.
systemic_review.regenerative_seed: Reusable evidence, an improved method, and participant capability even when the hypothesis fails.

resource_ledger.baseline_comparison: Budget only material resource types, measure actual use in separate units, and compare with the current process.
resource_ledger.restoration: Rollback the change, restore affected resources and access, and return learning when the stop rule fires.

plain_language.comprehension_check: Participants can state the hypothesis, exposure, measures, stop condition, rollback, and next decision.
